Metadata.Frequency: Data are updated twice a year

columns.name: Start Census Tract
columns.description: The Census Tract where the trip started.

columns.name: End Census Tract
columns.description: The Census Tract where the trip ended.

columns.name: Trip Count
columns.description: Count of trips for this combination of starting and ending Census Tracts.

columns.name: Start Community Area Number
columns.description: The Community Area number where the trip started.

columns.name: End Community Area Number
columns.description: The Community Area number where the trip ended.

columns.name: Start Community Area Name
columns.description: The Community Area name where the trip started.

columns.name: End Community Area Name
columns.description: The Community Area name where the trip ended.

columns.name: Start Centroid Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the center of the trip start Census Tract (or Community Area if Census Tract is blank for privacy). This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: Start Centroid Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the center of the trip start Census Tract (or Community Area if Census Tract is blank for privacy). This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: Start Centroid Location
columns.description: The location of the center of the trip start Census Tract (or Community Area if Census Tract is blank for privacy). This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the center of the trip end Census Tract (or Community Area if Census Tract is blank for privacy). This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the center of the trip end Census Tract (or Community Area if Census Tract is blank for privacy). This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Location
columns.description: The location of the center of the trip end Census Tract (or Community Area if Census Tract is blank for privacy). This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: Unique_ID
columns.description: A unique ID defined by the Year, Start Census Tract, and End Census Tract
